title: Memory queue purges can race with consumers and raise IndexError
author: IlyaKhalafi
body_preview: The memory transport counts messages through `Queue.qsize()` and then clears `Queue.queue` outside the queue mutex. A consumer can acquire the mutex after the count, find a message, and reach `deque.popleft()` after the purge removes it. This raises `IndexError` instead of returning a message or `queue.Empty`. title: RQ cron scheduler does not respect Django TIME_ZONE
author: chromium7
body_preview: ## Summary  Cron expressions registered through `django_rq` are evaluated in UTC instead of the timezone configured in Django's `TIME_ZONE`.
